links.outcome: Readability of LLM chatbot responses against a sixth-grade target, measured with six indices
links.effect: No model met the sixth-grade target. Copilot was easiest to read but had median FKGL 11.65 and FRES 38.60.
links.quote: No model met the prespecified sixth-grade readability target; Copilot was descriptively easiest to read, but its median FKGL was 11.65 and FRES 38.60.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four commercial LLM chatbots answering public-facing health queries, evaluating readability and clinical information quality without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
